It feels impossible to actually get through to speak to someone, and when you finally do, the response is often unhelpful and dismissive.

The way patients are treated, especially those struggling with mental health, is deeply concerning. Instead of feeling supported or listened to, I felt rushed, unheard, and not taken seriously.
